evals.prompt: Can the Glens make top 6? What do they need to do?
Which of our remaining games matter the most?
What's our best case and worst case for the rest of the season?

analysis.summary: The with-skill configuration passed all 16 assertions (100%) vs baseline at 14/16 (87.5%). The skill improved output on two dimensions: (1) providing multiple concrete scenarios instead of just extremes in the top-6 analysis, and (2) considering rival team results in the best/worst case analysis. Both configurations performed equally well on the key-games eval, suggesting the skill's biggest value-add is in structured scenario analysis rather than game prioritization.
discriminating_assertions: Provides at least one concrete scenario (eval 0) - with_skill provided 5 scenarios, baseline only mentioned winning all games
Considers how other teams' results affect Glens position (eval 2) - with_skill discussed Modesto dropping points, baseline did not
non_discriminating_assertions: All eval 1 assertions passed for both configurations - game prioritization works well without the skill
